# Copilot Instructions for Open Lap

[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root is the single source of truth:
ground rules, architecture, build and verification, translation rules, the
*Code Review* procedure and *Maintainer Decisions*. Read it first and follow it.
If a convention changes, update `AGENTS.md`, not this file.

Code reviews follow the *Code Review* section of `AGENTS.md`: amend
`.github/copilot-review.md` in place, priority-ordered finding tables, resolved
items removed, settled matters recorded under *Maintainer Decisions* and not
re-raised, and a review changes no code.
